title: CAPEC-100: Overflow buffers
prerequisites: the target performs a buffer operation whose bounds-checking is missing or inadequate
an input vector that reaches that buffer operation with attacker-chosen content and length
excerpt: The pattern walks from locating an input vector that reaches a buffer operation, through sizing how far past the allocation a write can go without crashing the process immediately, to shaping the overflow content so it changes a specific value, pointer or control-flow target on purpose. It names the locate-size-shape sequence rather than a specific shellcode, which is why it is useful for ordering an exploitation attempt against a candidate overflow: confirm the write reaches past the boundary first, then grow it under control, before attempting to redirect execution.
